description: This file defines the OpenIdServerSettingsDisplayDriver class, which manages the display and update logic for OpenId server settings within OrchardCore. It handles rendering the settings UI, authorizing access, and applying updates to the settings model.

classes.name: OpenIdServerSettingsDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for managing the display and editing of OpenId server settings in OrchardCore.

methods.name: OpenIdServerSettingsDisplayDriver
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for the display driver.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Handles rendering the settings edit UI, including authorization checks and populating available certificates.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to the OpenId server settings based on user input, with authorization checks.
